arxiv-2209-00498.title: NODE IK: Solving Inverse Kinematics with Neural Ordinary Differential Equations for Path Planning psh117@snu.ac.kr cadop@njit.edu park73@snu.ac.kr
arxiv-2209-00498.creator: Suhan Park, Mathew Schwartz, Jaeheung Park
arxiv-2209-00498.description: Abstract This paper proposes a novel inverse kinematics (IK) solver of articulated robotic systems for path planning. IK is a traditional but essential problem for robot manipulation. Recently, data-driven methods have been proposed to quickly solve the IK for path planning. These methods can handle a large amount of IK requests at once with the advantage of GPUs.

arxiv-2305-01056.title: From Organizations to Individuals: Psychoactive Substance Use By Professional Programmers
arxiv-2305-01056.creator: Kaia Newman, Madeline Endres, Westley Weimer, Brittany Johnson
arxiv-2305-01056.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kaia Newman, Madeline Endres, Westley Weimer, Brittany Johnson. Psychoactive substances, which influence the brain to alter perceptions and moods, have the potential to have positive and negative effects on critical software engineering tasks. They are widely used in software, but that use is not well understood. We present the results of the first qualitative investigation of the experiences of, and challenges faced by, psychoactive substance users in professional software communities.

arxiv-2305-12481.title: Compact Lattice Gadget and Its Applications to Hash-and-Sign Signatures
arxiv-2305-12481.creator: Yang Yu, Huiwen Jia, Xiaoyun Wang
arxiv-2305-12481.description: Abstract Lattice gadgets and the associated algorithms are the essential building blocks of lattice-based cryptography. In the past decade, they have been applied to build versatile and powerful cryptosystems. However, the practical optimizations and designs of gadget-based schemes generally lag their theoretical constructions.

arxiv-2308-07969.title: Mirrorless lasing: a theoretical perspective
arxiv-2308-07969.creator: Aneesh Ramaswamy, Jabir Chathanathil, Dimitra Kanta, Emmanuel Klinger, Aram Papoyan, Svetlana Shmavonyan, Aleksandr Khanbekyan, Arne Wickenbrock, Dmitry Budker, Svetlana A. Malinovskaya
arxiv-2308-07969.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aneesh Ramaswamy, Jabir Chathanathil, Dimitra Kanta, Emmanuel Klinger, Aram Papoyan, Svetlana Shmavonyan, Aleksandr Khanbekyan, Arne Wickenbrock, Dmitry Budker, Svetlana A. Malinovskaya. Mirrorless lasing has been a topic of particular interest for about a decade due to promising new horizons for quantum science and applications.

arxiv-2405-06010.title: The miniJPAS Survey: The radial distribution of star formation rates in faint X-ray active galactic nuclei
arxiv-2405-06010.creator: Nischal Acharya, Silvia Bonoli, Mara Salvato, Ariana Cortesi, Rosa M. González Delgado, Ivan Ezequiel Lopez, Isabel Marquez, Ginés Martínez-Solaeche, Abdurro’uf, David Alexander, Marcella Brusa, Jonás Chaves-Montero, Juan Antonio Fernández Ontiveros, Brivael Laloux, Andrea Lapi, George Mountrichas,
arxiv-2405-06010.description: Abstract We study the impact of black hole nuclear activity on both the global and radial star formation rate (SFR) profiles in X-ray-selected active galactic nuclei (AGN) in the field of miniJPAS, the precursor of the much wider J-PAS project. Our sample includes 32 AGN with z < 0.3 z<0.3 detected via the XMM-Newton and Chandra surveys.

arxiv-2407-17623.title: SAfEPaTh: A System-Level Approach for Efficient Power and Thermal Estimation of Convolutional Neural Network Accelerator
arxiv-2407-17623.creator: Yukai Chen 1 , Simei Yang 1 , Debjyoti Bhattacharjee 1 , Francky Catthoor 1 , Arindam Mallik 1
arxiv-2407-17623.description: Abstract The design of energy-efficient, high-performance, and reliable Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) accelerators involves significant challenges due to complex power and thermal management issues. This paper introduces SAfEPaTh, a novel system-level approach for accurately estimating power and temperature in tile-based CNN accelerators.

arxiv-2408-08949.title: Demonstration of hybrid foreground removal on CHIME data
arxiv-2408-08949.creator: Haochen Wang 1,2, Kiyoshi Masui 1,2, Kevin Bandura 3,4, Arnab Chakraborty 5,6, Matt Dobbs 5,6, Simon Foreman 7, Liam Gray 8, Mark Halpern 8, Albin Joseph 7, Joshua MacEachern 8, Juan Mena-Parra 9,10, Kyle Miller 5,6, Laura Newburgh 11, Sourabh Paul 12,5, Alex Reda 11, Pranav Sanghavi 11, Seth Siegel
arxiv-2408-08949.description: Abstract The main challenge of 21 cm cosmology experiments is astrophysical foregrounds which are difficult to separate from the signal due to telescope systematics. An earlier study has shown that foreground residuals induced by antenna gain errors can be estimated and subtracted using the hybrid foreground residual subtraction (HyFoReS) technique which relies on cross-correlating linearly filtered data.

arxiv-2412-04405.title: Baryon Acoustic Oscillations from galaxy surveys Baryon Acoustic Oscillations from galaxy surveys
arxiv-2412-04405.creator: Ribamar R. R. Reis
arxiv-2412-04405.description: Abstract \emph{Keywords} Observational Cosmology, BAO, LSS, galaxy surveys 1 Introduction The cosmological standard model states that the universe was hot and dense in the past and has been expanding since then. During this early epoch, matter was completely ionised and tightly coupled to radiation, which is relativistic matter.

arxiv-2501-06327.title: OpenFOAMGPT: a RAG-Augmented LLM Agent for OpenFOAM-Based Computational Fluid Dynamics
arxiv-2501-06327.creator: Sandeep Pandey, Ran Xu, Wenkang Wang, Xu Chu
arxiv-2501-06327.description: Abstract This work presents a large language model (LLM)-based agent OpenFOAMGPT tailored for OpenFOAM-centric computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations, leveraging two foundation models from OpenAI: the GPT-4o and a chain-of-thought (CoT)–enabled o1 preview model. Both agents demonstrate success across multiple tasks.

arxiv-2602-04945.title: Incommensurate pair-density-wave correlations in two-leg ladder t t – J J – J ⟂ J_{\perp} model
arxiv-2602-04945.creator: Hanbit Oh, Julian May-Mann, Ya-Hui Zhang
arxiv-2602-04945.description: Abstract We report the discovery of a generalized Luther-Emery liquid phase characterized by incommensurate pair-density-wave (iC-PDW) correlations in the two-leg t t - J J - J ⟂ J_{\perp} ladder model. By tuning the potential difference between the legs, we explore the regime of intermediate layer polarization P P .

pmc-10673439.creator: Milos Glisic, Tamara Nikolic Turnic, Vladimir Zivkovic, Bozidar Pindovic, Natalia Vasilievna Chichkova, Vladimir Petrovich Fisenko, Marina Nikolic, Lazar Stijak, Lemina Elena Yurievna, Mirjana Veselinovic, Milena Jovicic, Katarina Mihajlovic, Sergey Bolevich, Vladimir Jakovljevic, Francisco Epelde

pmc-11417481.title: Prediction of presence and severity of metabolic syndrome using regional body volumes measured by a multisensor white-light 3D scanner and validation using a mobile technology
pmc-11417481.creator: Betsy J Medina Inojosa, Virend K Somers, Kyla Lara-Breitinger, Lynne A Johnson, Jose R Medina-Inojosa, Francisco Lopez-Jimenez
pmc-11417481.description: AimsTo test whether an index based on the combination of demographics and body volumes obtained with a multisensor 3D body volume (3D-BV) scanner and biplane imaging using a mobile application (myBVI®) will reliably predict the severity and presence of metabolic syndrome (MS).Methods and resultsWe enrolled 1280 consecutive subjects who completed study protocol measurements, including 3D-BV and myBVI®.

pmc-12699802.title: Polygenicity and APOE ε4 shape response to intervention in mild cognitive impairment
pmc-12699802.creator: Jiyun Hwang, So Young Moon, Harim Lee, Jaejin Lee, Yoo Kyoung Park, Jee Hyang Jeong, Chang Hyung Hong, Jiwoo Jung, Hae Ri Na, Soo Hyun Cho, Joohon Sung, Soo Ji Lee, Seong Hye Choi
pmc-12699802.description: BackgroundMultidomain lifestyle interventions have shown effectiveness in preventing dementia, but identifying high-risk groups most likely to benefit remains unclear.MethodsWe re-evaluated the SUPERBRAIN-MEET multidomain intervention study in mild cognitive impairment (MCI) patients, incorporating polygenic risk scores (PRS) for Alzheimer’s disease and APOE ε4 status using Repeatable Battery for the Assessment of Neuropsychological Status (RBANS) total index as the primary outcome.

pmc-12937371.creator: Sonja Aaltonen, Jari Jokelainen, Vilma Kantonen, Juulia Kinnunen, Laura Huilaja, Suvi-Päivikki Sinikumpu
pmc-12937371.description: mptoms include fever, chills and general malaise. In severe cases, cellulitis can lead to abscess formation, necrotizing fasciitis and septicaemia (2). The diagnosis of cellulitis is based on clinical assessment, but laboratory tests may be useful to assess the severity of the infection (3). Blood cultures are used to detect bacteraemia (4).

pmc-13056170.title: Mapping the role of tumor necrosis factor-related apoptosis-inducing ligand (TRAIL) and its receptors in chronic kidney disease: A scoping review protocol
pmc-13056170.creator: Hansani Niroshika, Harshi Weerakoon, Nalaka Herath, Kosala Weerakoon, Prasad Jayasooriya, Jie Yang, Jie Yang, Jie Yang
pmc-13056170.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is increasingly recognized as a global public health concern, impacting about 800 million people worldwide. Despite having different CKD etiologies, apoptosis, inflammation and fibrosis are the central mechanisms of pathogenesis. Tumor necrosis factor (TNF)- related apoptosis-inducing ligand (TRAIL) is a critical regulator of these mechanisms, suggesting a prominent role in pathogenesis and progression of CKD.

pmc-13248207.title: Comparative Outcomes of Total Versus Partial Pericardiectomy in Constrictive Pericarditis: A Two-Decade Single-Centre Experience
pmc-13248207.creator: Karim R Moawad, Mostafa M Elbadry Mohamed, Mohamed Abdelkhalik, Hazem Aljasem, Jason Kho, Dimitrios Pousious, Sunil K Ohri
pmc-13248207.description: ObjectivesThe optimal extent of pericardial resection in constrictive pericarditis (CP) remains a subject of surgical debate. This study compared perioperative outcomes, postoperative right ventricular (RV) function, functional status, and long-term survival between total and partial pericardiectomy in a contemporaneous single-centre cohort.

pmc-13360985.title: EEG Neurofeedback for Attention and Executive Functions in Intellectual Disability: A Systematic Review of Treatment Studies
pmc-13360985.creator: Marilena Recupero, Raffaele Ferri, Serafino Buono
pmc-13360985.description: Background: EEG neurofeedback has been proposed as a non-pharmacological approach to enhance attention and cognitive performance in neurodevelopmental conditions. However, its efficacy in individuals with intellectual disability (ID) remains limited. Methods: We conducted a systematic review of treatment studies evaluating EEG-based neurofeedback targeting attention and executive function outcomes in participants with ID.

pmc-13570410.title: Robotic Resection With Hyperthermic Intrathoracic Perfusion Chemotherapy for Thymoma Recurrence
pmc-13570410.creator: Paula Duarte D′Ambrosio, Gustavo Schvartsman, Mathias de Souza Ribeiro, Enzo Campedelli Borges, Marina Cardoso de Castro, Paulo Manuel Pêgo Fernandes, Ricardo Mingarini Terra, Lipi Buch
pmc-13570410.description: Thymoma recurrence with pleural dissemination remains a therapeutic challenge, often requiring multimodal treatment strategies. Cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intrathoracic chemotherapy (HITHOC) has emerged as a promising approach for selected patients; however, reports using minimally invasive robotic platforms are limited.

uslaw-usc-t40-s17102.title: 40 U.S.C. § 17102 — Prohibition on acquisition or purchase of motor vehicles by Federal Government
uslaw-usc-t40-s17102.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t40-s17102.description: United States Code, Title 40 (Public Buildings, Property, And Works); Chapter 171 (Safety Standards For Motor Vehicles). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Federal Government shall not purchase a motor vehicle for use by the Government unless that motor vehicle is equipped with reasonable passenger safety devices that the Administrator of General Services requires. Those devices shall conform with standards the Administrator.
